encoding.address: Solidity ABI address, left-padded to one 32-byte word

identifiers.commitId: keccak256(utf8("git-sha1:" + lowercase40HexObjectId)) for SHA-1 repositories, or the corresponding git-sha256 form with 64 lowercase hex characters
identifiers.deployedRuntimeCodeHash: EVM EXTCODEHASH of the exact deployed address

launchApprovalAndRegistration.launchId: Projection V2 SHA-256/RFC 8785 ID carried onchain as raw bytes32
launchApprovalAndRegistration.requirements: Integrations MUST call the canonical helpers or produce byte-identical abi.encode output. Approval is exact-revision and one-use.

partnerConfiguration.configurationHash: keccak256(abi.encode(CONFIGURATION_DOMAIN, modelHash, factoryHash, bytes32 permissionsHash, bytes32 feePolicyHash))
partnerConfiguration.factoryHash: keccak256(abi.encode(bytes32 factorySourceRepositoryId, bytes32 factorySourceCommitId, uint256 chainId, address factory, bytes32 factoryRuntimeCodeHash, bytes32 launchRuntimeCodeSetHash))
partnerConfiguration.modelHash: keccak256(abi.encode(bytes32 providerId, bytes32 modelId, bytes32 modelVersion, bytes32 templateId, bytes32 templateVersion, bytes32 modelRepositoryId, bytes32 modelSourceCommitId))

requirements.launchRuntimeCodeSetHash: Approved sorted duplicate-free set of every runtime-code hash reachable in the launch plan
requirements.permissionsHash: All owner, admin, upgrade, pause, custody, oracle, bridge and claim authorities

feePolicy.attributionHash: keccak256(abi.encode(uint8 kind, bytes32 providerId, bytes32 partnerStatusId, bytes32 modelId, bytes32 modelVersion, bytes32 templateId, bytes32 templateVersion, bytes32 marketPathId, bytes32 partnerRepositoryId, bytes32 partnerCommitId, bytes32 partnerRuntimeCodeSetHash))
feePolicy.economicsHash: keccak256(abi.encode(uint16 totalFeeBps, uint16 nativeCustomFeeBps, bytes32 partnerLegHash, bytes32 programmableLegHash))
feePolicy.legHash: keccak256(abi.encode(uint16 shareBps, address recipient, address currency, bytes32 chargeModeId, bytes32 basisId, bytes32 roundingId, bytes32 accrualId, bytes32 claimId, bytes32 claimRightId, bytes32 controlEvidenceHash))
feePolicy.lifecycleAndEvidenceHash: keccak256(abi.encode(bytes32 activationVersion, uint64 activationBlock, bool paused, bool retired, bytes32 publicPolicyBindingHash, bytes32 claimIsolationEvidenceHash, bytes32 accountingSafetyEvidenceHash, bytes32 verificationEvidenceHash))
feePolicy.requirements: There is no global partner surcharge and no fallback 10-bps fee. A non-AEON partner entry is not launchable under PartnerTemplate until a published verifier version defines its exact fee plan.
